title: sarcocapnos baetica subsp. integrifolia
intro: Sarcocapnos baetica subsp. integrifolia, commonly known as the Spanish catchfly, is a flowering plant species in the Papaveraceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sarcocapnos baetica subsp. integrifolia include expectorant and bronchodilator effects, which help to relieve respiratory congestion and promote easy breathing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as berberine and sanguinarine, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
